info.title: AI Gateway Inference API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible inference and speech-to-text, and native AWS Bedrock inference endpoints, with scoped API keys and credit settlement.

post.description: Translates an OpenAI Chat Completions request to AWS Bedrock Converse. Requires `ai.invoke`.

200.description: A completion, or a server-sent event stream. A stream ends with `data: [DONE]`, or with an `error` event (`{"error": {"message", "type", "code", "param"}}`, code `stream_interrupted` or `upstream_error`) when the upstream breaks off the response before the model finished it.

post.description: OpenAI's transcription API (`client.audio.transcriptions.create` in OpenAI's SDKs). Transcribes an audio or video file with a model whose upstream model accepts audio, such as Mistral's Voxtral models on Bedrock, and returns the transcript as `response_format` asks: `json`, `text`, `verbose_json` with timed segments, `srt` or `vtt`. The gateway sends only the file's speech to the model, in chunks of up to 59.5 seconds, up to 6 at a time, and settles the tokens of all chunks as one usage event under the request ID. Every successful response reports that usage in the `x-usage-*` headers. Errors after the model is chosen and credits are admitted carry `x-request-id`, and also the `x-usage-*` headers when chunks answered before the failure were charged. Streaming and word timestamps are not supported. Requires `ai.invoke`.

200.description: The transcript in the requested `response_format`: `json` and `verbose_json` as JSON, `text` as plain text, `srt` as SRT and `vtt` as WebVTT subtitles.

schema.description: SRT subtitles (`srt`): at most two lines of 42 characters per cue
WebVTT subtitles (`vtt`): at most two lines of 42 characters per cue

post.description: The gateway's subtitle API. Makes subtitles for an audio or video file as SRT (the default), WebVTT, or JSON cues. A cue has at most `max_lines` lines of at most `max_line_length` characters, broken where the lines come out about even, and stays on screen for at most 7 seconds. A pause of 0.8 seconds or more starts a new cue, and so does the end of a sentence, unless the next sentence follows within 0.3 seconds and fits on the same line. A cue shorter than 1 second stays up to 1 second when the next cue leaves room; cues never overlap. Takes the `file`, `model`, `language`, `prompt` and `temperature` fields of `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, and settles usage and reports it in headers the same way. Requires `ai.invoke`.

200.description: The subtitles in the requested `response_format`: `srt` as SRT, `vtt` as WebVTT, `json` as cues.

schema.description: WebVTT subtitles (`vtt`); `&`, `<` and `>` in cue text are escaped

get.description: Lists every enabled model, model alias and mapped app tier ID, each with its display name, its model's context window and output limit, and the reasoning efforts it takes. Requires `models.read`.

Returns the key owner's current balance, monthly allocation, how the allocation works (reset or rollover, with any rollover cap) and any monthly spend limit with what it leaves this month. Requires `credits.read`.

Returns the authenticated key owner's metered USD spend, current credits, allocation percentage, request count, and detailed token totals for the current UTC calendar month. The period end is exclusive, percentage is not capped, and it is null for a zero allocation. Requires `credits.read`.

Returns the authenticated key owner's daily spend, token, request, model, Bedrock provider, and opaque API-key breakdowns using the core LiteLLM `/user/daily/activity` response shape. This focused compatibility subset is non-paginated and accepts no target user. Dates are inclusive UTC dates and the maximum range is 366 days. Requires `credits.read`.

200.description: Daily usage activity in descending date order

post.description: Passes a Bedrock Converse-shaped request through the configured catalog and settlement boundary. Requires `ai.invoke`.
Returns Bedrock Converse stream events as newline-delimited JSON. Requires `ai.invoke`.
Passes a native model body to Bedrock InvokeModel. Requires `ai.invoke`.
Passes native provider event bytes through as an octet stream. Requires `ai.invoke`.

inferenceKey.description: An inference API key created in Profile, API & usage.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Stable ID for exactly-once credit settlement across retries.

AudioRequestId.description: The request ID the usage is settled under: the request's `X-Request-ID`, or a generated `audio-<uuid>` when it sent none or an invalid one.

UsageInputTokens.description: Input tokens of all the model requests of the transcription

UsageOutputTokens.description: Output tokens of all the model requests of the transcription

UsageCostStatus.description: `settled`, or `failed` when ledger settlement failed. A failed status is not free usage.

UsageCost.description: The charged USD amount, a decimal with up to 8 decimal places such as `0.0000158`. Only when `x-usage-cost-status` is `settled`; `0` for audio without speech.

body.description: Native request body for the selected model

InsufficientCredits.description: The user has no available credits (code insufficient_credits) or has reached their monthly spend limit (code monthly_spend_limit_reached)

Unavailable.description: Bedrock is not configured (`provider_not_configured`), is unavailable, or cannot be reached (`service_unavailable`, with a message that names no upstream address)

AudioBadRequest.description: An invalid request (`invalid_content_type`, `invalid_multipart`, `missing_required_parameter`, `invalid_request`, `invalid_language`, `unsupported_value` for word timestamps, `unsupported_parameter` for streaming), an unavailable model (`model_not_available`), or a file the gateway cannot read (`unsupported_audio_format`, `audio_decode_failed`, `audio_too_long`). Bedrock's validation errors, for example from a model that does not accept audio, are `invalid_request` with Bedrock's message.

FileTooLarge.description: The file is larger than 25 MB (`file_too_large`)

url.description: A base64 data:image/... URL or a public http(s) URL that the gateway downloads. PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP; up to 3.75 MB.

content.description: Image parts are a gateway extension forwarded inside the Bedrock tool result

temperature.description: Omitted when the gateway enables Claude reasoning

top_p.description: Omitted when the gateway enables Claude reasoning

max_completion_tokens.description: Alias for max_tokens; takes precedence when both are sent

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for models with reasoning enabled. Mapped to Claude adaptive thinking and output_config.effort, Claude thinking budgets, Nova 2 reasoningConfig, or gpt-oss reasoning_effort. Unsupported levels are clamped to the nearest supported level; omitted values use the model's configured default.

tool_choice.description: auto, required, none, or a named function

prompt_tokens.description: Includes uncached input, cache reads and cache writes; do not add cache counts again.

cost.description: Actual settled ledger charge in USD. Present only after successful settlement; a known zero is valid.

cost_details.description: Optional accounting extension. Settled includes calculated category costs (before balance capping); failed/unavailable omit unknown fields and cost. Streaming final usage replaces earlier usage for the same completion id and precedes DONE.

reasoning_content.description: Non-standard: summarized model reasoning when the model returns readable reasoning

name.description: Display name: the model's or alias's name, or `<app> / <tier>` for an app tier.

context_window.description: The model's configured context window in tokens; an alias and its app tiers list their upstream model's. Null when none is configured.

max_output_tokens.description: The model's output limit in tokens: the most a request may ask for (max_tokens, max_completion_tokens or max_output_tokens), and the limit a request without one gets. An alias and its app tiers list their upstream model's.

efforts.description: The reasoning_effort values a request may send, lowest first. Empty for a model without reasoning enabled, and for a pinned alias and its app tiers.

default_effort.description: One of efforts: the effort a request without reasoning_effort runs at. Null when no default effort is configured or the ID takes no effort, so the model's own default applies.

effort.description: Pinned aliases and their app tiers only: the effort every request runs at, or none when the alias turns thinking off without one.

CreditControl.description: How the account's monthly allocation works and its monthly spend limit. Gateways from before these fields omit them; treat that as the reset mode without a cap or limit.

monthly_credit_mode.description: What the monthly run does with monthly_allocation: reset replaces the balance with it (unspent credits expire); rollover adds it to the balance (unspent credits carry over), trimmed so the balance does not pass rollover_cap.

rollover_cap.description: Rollover mode: the balance the monthly allocation may bring the account up to; at or above it the allocation is skipped. Null: no cap. Ignored in reset mode.

monthly_spend_limit.description: The most metered usage the account may be charged in a UTC calendar month, whatever its balance. Once reached, inference returns 402 monthly_spend_limit_reached until the next month. Null: no limit.

monthly_spend_remaining.description: What monthly_spend_limit leaves this month: the limit less this month's metered spend, never below zero. The account can spend the lesser of this and its balance. Null without a limit.

PeriodBudget.description: Version 1 authoritative owner-wide current-UTC-month budget. Available only after exact complete-ledger reconciliation in one database snapshot, without tolerance for missing history or rounding drift. Amounts are USD. Older APIs may omit this object; clients must treat absence or unsupported versions as unknown, not zero.

reason.description: Null when available. Otherwise unsupported/malformed ledger events, committed event timestamps later than observed_at, exact balance mismatch (including negative opening), or nonfinite response amounts.

opening_balance.description: All pre-month ledger additions less consumption: carry-in, not a new recurring grant.

top_ups.description: Current-month administrator additions, including initial funding within this month.

reset_additions.description: Sum of current-month positive monthly-run deltas: replacement resets and rollover allocations, including repeated runs.

reset_removals.description: Sum of current-month negative replacement-reset deltas, expressed positively. A rollover never removes credits.

net_funding.description: top_ups - adjustment_removals + reset_additions - reset_removals; may be negative. Allocation edits alone grant nothing.

metered_spend.description: Current-month charged usage/chat/api/embedding consumption. Still reported when unavailable if finite, otherwise null.

remaining.description: Observed current account balance, equal in exact database arithmetic to effective_budget - metered_spend when available. Still reported when unavailable if finite, otherwise null.

percent_used.description: metered_spend / effective_budget * 100, uncapped. Null for zero denominator or unavailable budget. Positive-budget exhaustion is 100%.

observed_at.description: Database statement_timestamp labeling the single MVCC observation of account and ledger, not a historical replay cutoff. Visible committed events timestamped later than this make budget unavailable rather than being silently omitted.

used.description: Metered USD charged in this period; what monthly_spend_limit counts

balance.description: Current balance, not a historical period-end balance

percent_used.description: Legacy used divided by recurring allocation times 100, uncapped; null when allocation is zero. Unchanged and not top-up-inclusive; use available budget.percent_used for the authoritative period budget.

total.description: Input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens

total_tokens.description: Prompt plus completion tokens, matching LiteLLM semantics

file.description: The audio or video file, at most 25 MB, with up to 2 hours of audio: WAV, MP3, M4A, MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, OGG, Opus, FLAC, AAC, AIFF, CAF, AMR or AVI. The format is detected from the file's bytes, not its name or type. For a video file, the first audio track is transcribed.

model.description: A model ID, alias or app tier whose upstream model accepts audio, such as `mistral.voxtral-mini-3b-2507`

response_format.description: `srt` and `vtt` have at most two lines of 42 characters per cue

language.description: The spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code, such as `en` or `de`; a BCP 47 tag such as `en-US` is accepted and its language subtag used. Without it, the model detects the language. Other values return `invalid_language`.

prompt.description: Context for the model: the topic, names and terms, and their spelling

timestamp_granularities[].description: Only `segment` is accepted: timing is per sentence or clause. `word` returns `unsupported_value`.

file.description: The audio or video file, at most 25 MB, with up to 2 hours of audio: WAV, MP3, M4A, MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, OGG, Opus, FLAC, AAC, AIFF, CAF, AMR or AVI. The format is detected from the file's bytes, not its name or type. For a video file, the first audio track is transcribed.

model.description: A model ID, alias or app tier whose upstream model accepts audio, such as `mistral.voxtral-mini-3b-2507`

language.description: The spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code, such as `en` or `de`; a BCP 47 tag such as `en-US` is accepted and its language subtag used. Without it, the model detects the language. Other values return `invalid_language`.

prompt.description: Context for the model: the topic, names and terms, and their spelling

max_line_length.description: The longest line in characters; only a longer word makes a longer line

max_lines.description: The most lines in a cue

AudioUsage.description: OpenAI's token usage for transcriptions with the gateway's accounting: the tokens of all the model requests of the file, settled as one usage event.

seconds.description: Duration of the audio in seconds

cost.description: Actual settled ledger charge in USD. Present only after successful settlement; a known zero is valid, as for audio without speech.

cost_details.description: Settled includes the calculated costs (before balance or spend-limit capping); failed (a settlement error) omits them and cost, and is not free usage.

text.description: The transcript; empty when the file has no speech

language.description: The requested language's English name in lowercase, such as `english`; without `language`, a guess from the transcript's most common words, or `unknown`

duration.description: Duration of the audio in seconds

TranscriptionSegment.description: A sentence, timed approximately; a sentence longer than 30 seconds is split between its clauses. `tokens`, `avg_logprob`, `compression_ratio` and `no_speech_prob` are placeholders for OpenAI's Whisper fields.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the file

end.description: Seconds from the start of the file

language.description: The requested language's English name in lowercase, such as `english`; without `language`, a guess from the transcript's most common words, or `unknown`

duration.description: Duration of the audio in seconds

start.description: Seconds from the start of the file

end.description: Seconds from the start of the file; cues never overlap

lines.description: At most `max_lines` lines of at most `max_line_length` characters
